name: cognigy
description: NiCE Cognigy Plugin — create, test, and manage AI Agents on the NiCE Cognigy platform

interface.shortDescription: Build and test Cognigy AI Agents
interface.longDescription: Create, configure, test, and deploy AI Agents on the NiCE Cognigy platform over the Cognigy REST API. Covers the full loop — provisioning an agent with its flow, job node, and endpoint; attaching knowledge stores and tools; talking to the agent to evaluate responses; and deploying to Webchat or Voice Gateway.
defaultPrompt: List my Cognigy projects and the AI Agents in each one
Create a customer support AI Agent in my Cognigy project and test it
Add a knowledge store to my agent so it can answer from our docs
Audit my voice agent against the Go-Live Checklist
